title: Proventus Agrocom Ltd. (NSE Emerge: PROV) — Company Dossier
sector: Consumer Staples / Branded Dry Fruits & Healthy Snacking
entry_posture: NO_NEW_ALLOCATION; REJECTED (negative R:R across live support ₹1,992.92–₹2,129.15)
support_zone_explanation: The scanner's live support band of ₹1,992.92 to ₹2,129.15 sits around the rising 20-day EMA (₹2,097.68) and 10-week EMA (₹2,023.27) after the post-H1 FY27 spike to ₹2,345.00. Because our risk-adjusted 12-month Base fair value is ₹1,637—below the ₹1,748.39 structural stop itself—every live support level produces negative expected reward-to-risk (−1.29:1 at ₹2,129.15 and −1.46:1 at ₹1,992.92). The band is monitor-only; no buy orders are justified.
stop_placement_explanation: The ₹1,748.39 structural reference floor sits just under the rising 30-week SMA (₹1,778.31) on the 25 November 2026 TradingView feed (above our prior ₹1,692.11 floor). Because PROV trades on NSE Emerge with a 30-day average volume of 621 shares per day, any stop is an invalidation benchmark rather than a guaranteed execution fill.
primer: Proventus Agrocom (NSE Emerge: PROV) grows fast under its ProV brand, with H1 FY27 sales up 62.6% to ₹633.3 crore. Still, this November 2026 refresh downgrades new capital to REJECTED on VALUATION and CASH_FLOW (TIER_0). H1 operating cash flow fell to minus ₹57.64 crore while bank debt doubled to ₹56.41 crore. At ₹2,150.00 live (₹2,198.00 ledger), our ₹1,637 Base target sits below the ₹1,748.39 stop, leaving negative reward-to-risk everywhere. We hold 0 shares (NOT_HELD) and deploy our next rupee 30% to COFORGE and 70% to cash.
holding_rationale: The 23 November 2026 Zerodha positions ledger shows 0 shares of PROV across all accounts (net worth ₹42,64,304.99; cash ₹14,20,949.94, or 33.32%). With no position open and a REJECTED verdict on new capital, there are zero shares to hold, trim or sell and zero active buy orders. The triggers below are monitoring milestones only.

holding_alerts.trigger: Live price or pullback into scanner support band (₹1,992.92–₹2,129.15)
holding_alerts.instruction: Do not buy. At ₹2,150.00 live (₹2,198.00 ledger) and throughout ₹1,992.92–₹2,129.15, expected reward-to-risk to our ₹1,637 Base target is negative (−1.25:1 to −1.46:1) against the ₹1,748.39 stop. Keep allocation at 0%.

holding_alerts.trigger: Weekly close below rising 30-week structural floor
holding_alerts.instruction: Stage 2 uptrend ends; retain REJECTED status and do not attempt catch-a-falling-knife buys on an illiquid SME order book.

holding_alerts.trigger: FY2027 audited results (expected May 2027): positive full-year CFO, receivables <= ₹60 crore, and lower borrowings without dilution
holding_alerts.instruction: Cash-flow proof test: re-open fresh underwriting only if audited FY27 cash conversion confirms profit AND valuation resets to clear >= 1.50:1 reward-to-risk.

holding_alerts.trigger: Formal NSE Mainboard migration filing with full Ind AS transition statements (Ind AS 116/109/115)
holding_alerts.instruction: Quality and liquidity catalyst check: audit lease liabilities, receivable ECL provisions, and revenue-netting impact alongside mainboard lot-size removal before reconsidering.

holding_alerts.trigger: Consolidated borrowings above ₹75 crore at 31 March 2027, second negative half-year CFO, or any dilutive equity raise
holding_alerts.instruction: Permanent exclusion: keep PROV on the discarded list.

redeployment_plan.capital_source: The next marginal cash unit from Zerodha's ₹14,20,949.94 cash reserve (33.32% of ₹42,64,304.99 net worth on 23 November 2026); zero PROV proceeds are assumed because zero PROV shares are held

destinations.recommendation: Direct 30% of the marginal capital unit toward staged dip accumulation in COFORGE (CORE_ALPHA compounder; ACCUMULATE_ON_DIP; Stage 2; 23.5% ROCE; $2.38B order book).
destinations.rationale: COFORGE completed cycle-2 underwriting on 23 Nov 2026 with a ₹2,620 Base target and 1.67:1 support R:R (1.50:1 at the 25 Nov live TradingView close of ₹2,060.00, vs 23 Nov NSE ledger close ₹2,142.30), while Zerodha holds only a 2.06% weight (41 shares), leaving clean CORE_ALPHA headroom. Shortlist peer ZYDUSLIFE (25 Nov live TradingView close ₹1,236.00 vs 23 Nov NSE ledger close ₹1,199.50) moved above its ₹1,167.24–₹1,215.29 zone two days before a binary Nov 27 USFDA catalyst, so we do not chase it.
destinations.entry_condition: Stage limit buys on dips into ₹1,951.99–₹2,036.18 with hard stop at ₹1,685.64; this discipline applies under both the 25 Nov live TradingView close (₹2,060.00, inside snapshot support ₹1,951.99–₹2,066.72 and 1.2% above the dossier buy zone) and the 23 Nov NSE ledger close (₹2,142.30).

destinations.recommendation: Allocate 0% to outside equities until fully underwritten.
destinations.rationale: No outside equity completed 10-chapter monograph underwriting in this run. Mainboard packaged-food peer LT Foods (22.37x P/E, 8.21% operating margin, ₹910 Cr CFO) is far cheaper and stronger than PROV (38.67x, 2.06%) and merits a dedicated future dossier rather than an un-underwritten allocation.
destinations.entry_condition: Fund an outside name only after completing full 10-chapter underwriting with confirmed Stage 2 structure and >= 1.50:1 reward-to-risk.

destinations.recommendation: Keep 70% of the marginal capital unit in cash reserve.
destinations.rationale: PROV fails the 1.50:1 anti-hedging gate with negative expected R:R (−1.28:1 live; −1.29:1 to −1.46:1 at support), while broader Indian breadth is narrow (Nifty 50 −1.75% to 25,349.65; India VIX 17.70; 3 distribution days; only 48.2% of Nifty 500 above 200-DMA). Holding cash protects capital for cleaner Stage 2 pullbacks.
destinations.entry_condition: Deploy gradually when vetted Stage 2 compounders pull back into verified >= 1.50:1 support zones or after binary catalysts clear.

horizons.rationale: Down 6.32% over the past week beneath its 4-hour 20-EMA (₹2,154.79) on noisy SME volume averaging 621 shares/day (~₹13.4 lakh), with no F&O options chain and 4%–8% single-lot portfolio concentration.

Audited FY27 cash conversion, receivables back under ₹55–₹60 Cr, Surat Phases 2–3 execution, and an actual Ind AS NSE Mainboard migration filing remain unproven while the stock trades at 38.67x earnings.
Narrow moat with ~14% self-funded growth, 30%–34% quick-commerce take-rates above PROV's 23% brand gross margin, and aggressive private/FMCG rivals led by ₹1,600 Cr Nutraj and Farmley.

gate_exceptions: Session dating gap: The verified NSE ledger and positions cutoff is 23 November 2026 (PROV close ₹2,198.00; COFORGE ₹2,142.30; ZYDUSLIFE ₹1,199.50; Nifty 50 at 25,349.65). The live TradingView feed was pulled on 25–26 November 2026 (PROV ₹2,150.00, down 2.18%; COFORGE ₹2,060.00; ZYDUSLIFE ₹1,236.00). We date and state both feeds clearly. Our REJECTED call on PROV (−1.25:1 R:R at ₹2,198.00 and −1.28:1 at ₹2,150.00) and staged dip-buy discipline on COFORGE (₹1,951.99–₹2,036.18) hold under either close.

Scanned filings and SME lot size: Some past NSE SME PDFs, including the 13 November H1 FY27 outcome, are scanned files. We checked those numbers against the 25 November XBRL filing. We did not verify the live broker lot size after NSE circular NSE/CMTR/76688. We cite both the 160-share IPO lot (8.1% of net worth) and an 80-share lot (4.0% of net worth).

Technical tools and options: No live Chrome tab was open in this Linux run, so 1W, 1D and 4H chart reads come from the TradingView scanner feed. PROV is not in NSE F&O and has no listed options. TheWrap Stage 2 list only covers firms above ₹1,000 crore, so it leaves out ₹742.5 crore PROV.

Source dates: Past filings like the 2023 IPO prospectus, older annual reports, and the 2014 SEC Diamond Foods case keep their true dates. They sit next to fresh late-2026 filings, USDA and Wazir reports, and 23–25 November market feeds.
